mn109:0.2: This sutta is the same as Saṃyutta xxii, no. 82.
mn109:2.1: The full moon falls on the last day, the fifteenth, of the bright half of the lunar month, when the moon is waxing.
mn109:4.1: The formula at the end of this exchange—delighting in and approving of the Blessed One’s words before asking a further question—is repeated before each following question in Saṃyutta xxii, 82.
mn109:9.10: Cf. the four stations of consciousness (viññāṇaṭṭhiti) at Saṃyutta xxii, 54 (= Dīgha 33), for name-and-form as condition for consciousness.
mn109:12.1: For this theme of gratification, danger and escape, see Sutta 13.
mn109:14.3: By ‘affect’ here (Pali ‘touch’, phusissanti) one should understand that kammas done by what is not self would still have an effect on someone or something.
mn109:14.8: ‘Trained by me through questioning’ (paṭiccavinītā) is not commented on in either the Papañcasūdanī (the Majjhima Commentary) or the Sāratthappakāsinī (the Saṃyutta Commentary). The reference is probably to Sutta 38 and similar teachings there on dependent origination.
